wholePhysicalScope: The curved front, inset belfry bases, rear volume and approach stair axis follow the exact OSM topology. The original postcard and heritage texts control the façade composition and its distinguishing relief, twin finials and stairs.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the curved Rococo facade, twin rounded belfries, terracotta roof and approach stairs. Near views refine the bells, cornices and stone portal.
limitations: The native postcard is monochrome. The pale plaster, sandstone trim, painted wood and terracotta are approximate colors, informed by historic materials.
Stone relief, carved escutcheon, tower crossfalls, rear openings and roof details are modeled at medium fidelity. No interior or garden furnishing is modeled.
The source field resolves the hill and slope. It cannot resolve individual steps or certify survey-grade positioning. The stair width, tread count and foundation contacts are estimates.
